headline: "If You Deposit 3.6 Million Won, We'll Add 130,000 Won" - 10,000 People Flocked in Just Two Days, Unprecedented [Money News]
summary: As stock market volatility rises, funds seeking stable returns are moving back into bank deposits and savings. Banks are offering special products with annual rates in the 7-10% range.
why: Shifts between equities and bank deposits affect bank funding costs and household savings flows. Deposit rate competition is closely watched as a signal of liquidity conditions.
